notes.embabelAgentVersion: Latest Embabel release verified to build and pass the scaffold tests. Check https://github.com/embabel/embabel-agent/releases before bumping.
notes.springBootVersion: Embabel 1.5.x is built on Spring Boot 4.x / Spring AI 2.x. Spring Boot 3.5.x does NOT work with it (missing Spring AI auto-configuration classes).
notes.javaVersion: Default target for generated projects (current LTS). Embabel itself is built for Java 21, so --java-version 21 also works.
notes.kotlinVersion: Gradle Kotlin projects only (Maven takes it from the Spring Boot parent). Keep it equal to the kotlin.version managed by the Spring Boot version above.
notes.gradleVersion: Gradle wrapper in assets/project-template/gradle. Change it with ./gradlew wrapper --gradle-version <x> and copy the wrapper files back.
